types.name: is_active
types.description: Whether the product category is active.

types.name: is_internal
types.description: Whether the product category is internal. This can be used to only show the product category to admins and hide it from customers.

types.name: rank
types.description: The ranking of the category among sibling categories.

types.name: parent_category_id
types.description: The ID of the parent product category, if it has any.

types.name: external_id
types.description: An external identifier for the product category, such as an ID from a third-party system.

types.name: metadata
types.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.
